thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패. 꺼진 공장 vs 빛나는 공장, 가운데 놀란 50대 남성 (추천 구도)
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic high-saturation HDR image split into three parts. On the left, a dark abandoned 1990s Korean snack factory with dusty cold blue-grey machinery, faded unbranded cookie boxes and lights switched off. In the center, an attractive Korean man in his 50s with a warm likeable face, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, jaw-dropped and awestruck, looking toward the right side. On the right, a bright working snack production line bathed in golden backlight, glowing rim light and lens flare, freshly baked biscuits streaming along the conveyor, shown larger and closer with a heroic low-angle shot. No logos and no brand names on the factory buildings. Keep the bottom 35-40% darker and simple for text.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패. 닫힌 공장 vs 트럭이 드나드는 공장, 가운데 팔짱 낀 기술자
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic triumphant cinematic HDR scene of two Korean confectionery factory buildings side by side, unbranded with no logos. The left factory is old and desaturated, its rolling shutter closed, rust and dust on the walls under a cold grey sky. The right factory is larger and closer in a heroic low-angle shot, glowing in golden sunset backlight with sparks of light, delivery trucks loading snack boxes at its gate. In the center, a confident proud Korean engineer in his 50s in a clean work uniform stands with arms crossed and a warm smile, chest-up, filling most of the frame height. Keep the bottom 35-40% darker and simple for text.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패. 서류 더미에 묻힌 그룹 본사 vs 불 켜진 과자 공장, 가운데 놀란 직장인
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic high-saturation HDR image split into three parts. On the left, a tall grey 1990s Korean corporate headquarters tower with no logo under a stormy sky, desaturated and cold, stacks of stamped loan documents and promissory notes piled at its entrance. In the center, an attractive Korean office worker in his 50s with a warm likeable face in a 1990s suit, chest-up close-up filling 60% of the frame height, eyes wide and mouth open, looking toward the right side. On the right, a modest unbranded Korean confectionery factory shown larger and closer in a heroic low-angle shot, windows glowing warm gold, workers loading snack boxes onto a truck, golden backlight, rim light and lens flare. Keep the bottom 35-40% darker and simple for text.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업. 갓 구운 와플 과자 한 개를 크게 + 60대 남성의 반가운 표정
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic close-up, bright vivid high-saturation colors. One golden butter waffle biscuit with a crisp grid pattern fills more than half of the upper frame, held between the fingers of an attractive Korean man in his 60s with a warm likeable face, who looks at it with a surprised, nostalgic smile from the right side. Warm golden backlight, glowing rim light on the biscuit edges, crumbs catching the light, softly blurred 1990s Korean corner store shelves behind. No packaging, no logos, no text. thumbnails.concept_ko: 실물 클로즈업. 1990년대 과자 봉지 하나를 크게 + 50대 여성의 놀란 표정
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic close-up, bright vivid high-saturation colors. One retro 1990s-style plain red snack bag with no logo and no lettering, its top torn open and peanut-coated fried snack sticks spilling out, fills more than half of the upper frame in sharp focus. Beside it, an attractive Korean woman in her 50s with a warm likeable face holds the bag and looks at the camera with an exaggerated surprised expression, mouth open.
